name: novel-writing-team
description: Multi-agent novel writing studio: outline, write, and critique in a dynamic loop for coherent long-form fiction.

displayDescription.en: Multi-agent long-form fiction studio: outline planning, chapter writing, and editorial critique collaborate in a dynamic loop to produce coherent, high-quality novels.
displayDescription.zh: 多智能体长篇小说创作团：大纲推进、正文写作、审稿修订动态协作，避免重复与设定漂移，写出连贯长篇。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 开始创作一部新小说（先搭世界观与主线）
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to write a novel. Please use the outline agent to set up the world and main plot, then start chapter one.

quickPrompts.en: Start a new novel: give me a world setting + main plot
quickPrompts.zh: 开始创作一部新小说（先搭世界观与主线）

quickPrompts.en: Continue writing, advance the main plot to chapter X
quickPrompts.zh: 继续续写，把主线推进到第 X 章

quickPrompts.en: Review the latest chapter for plot holes or inconsistencies
quickPrompts.zh: 检查最新章节有没有不合理或矛盾的地方
